spec.name: ink-hero-desktop
spec.description: A sticky hero scored in three stations: paper (h=0), wash (h=0.5), print (h=1). One ScrollTrigger publishes the hero progress h; the image develops from wash to print under the ink curve, the frame grows to full bleed, the headline bleeds in line by line, the scrim and nav settle in the second leg. Written BEFORE the component existed. Page: hero section 400vh + after section 100vh at 1440x900 -> 4500px document, 3600px of scroll; the hero owns global progress 0..0.75 (h = P * 4/3).

globalExpectations.easeRef: linear by construction: the raw sticky-stage progress, h = scrollY / 2700
globalExpectations.note: The ONE value every track reads. If this line fails, every scene failure below is a symptom.

expectations.note: CSS sticky stage inside a 400vh section: no pin spacer, no transformed ancestor. Constancy is the assertion.

easeShape.ref: ink cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1) over the leg window h 0.04-0.48

expectations.easeRef: ink = cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1): 0.066 at t=0.25, 0.636 at t=0.5, 0.954 at t=0.75 (observed on oneshot-sakura.vercel.app; motion-priors §3.2). Probes account for the leg window starting at h=0.04.
expectations.note: A linear scrub reads 0.25 at the first probe and fails it. The develop value is the shader's uProgress, published as a CSS var so the harness can read what the GPU was told.
Discrete: 0 below h=0.25, 1 below h=0.75, else 2. Drives the station rail; the cheapest proof the sequence is advancing rather than sliding.

expectations.easeRef: expo.out (GSAP blended form) over the window h 0.06-0.26; the hero scene's local progress IS h, so the segment h 0.05-0.30 puts the quarter probe at h=0.1125 (t=0.26, expo.out 0.84) and the half probe at h=0.175 (t=0.575, 0.98).
expectations.note: The reveal fraction is what drives the line's yPercent (100 -> 0). A linear scrub reads ~0.26 at the first probe and fails.

expectations.easeRef: expo.out, window h 0.14-0.34: an 0.08 stagger behind line 1

keys.label: no scrim at the wash station
scrim under the headline at print

expectations.note: Own-opacity 1 under an ancestor at 0 is the classic dead reveal; one key catches it.

scenes.label: After — the hero releases and the page continues

at the top at the end of the page

expectations.note: Proves the sticky section released and the document really is 4500px: the after section's top travels exactly one viewport across the last quarter of scroll. (Measured the section, not its vertically centered heading.)
